periods.time: vol-09 ch-004, evening third-round second match

name.zh: 黑铁一辉对莎拉·布拉德莉莉

periods.summary: Ikki fights Sara without Ittou Shura, overcomes her army, copied Edelweiss and final soul-image, and advances to the semifinals.
periods.cause: Ikki has promised to model for Sara only if she defeats him, while he must keep his promise to Stella and prove the path he chose to his father.
periods.process: Sara opens with Bright Yellow flash and summons a Necro Battalion. Ikki uses Nukiachi-like footwork to make concentrated gunfire miss, then charges when Sara spreads the firing line and cuts down the skeletons. Sara hides with Stone Gray and completes a copied Edelweiss. The phantom initially overwhelms Ikki with the world strongest sword, residual vacuum cuts and a ground-transmitted Dokuga no Tachi, but Ikki realizes Sara can reproduce appearance and power, not the inner thought process of a swordsman. He baits the victory-seeking phantom, exploits his one-sword first-strike advantage against dual swords, and even lets its blade bite into his skull to gain a fraction of time, cutting it apart. Sara then summons copied Ikkis and finally Mario Rosso, a giant swordsman embodying her own artistic soul and her father's face. Ikki's direct attack cannot pierce it, so he lures it into the vacuum cuts left by the phantom Edelweiss, catches his falling Intetsu in his teeth after both arms are smashed, and stabs Sara in the abdomen.
periods.outcome: Sara collapses and Ikki is declared the winner. Sara says she will not honor the promise to stop pursuing him, and Ikki accepts this as her stubborn artist nature. Ikki reaches the semifinals.
periods.aftermath: Rinna and Charlotte analyze the loss from Akatsuki's side, while Stella realizes the most terrifying part of Ikki's win was his willingness to use his skull as a shield against Edelweiss's blade. The final with Stella feels within reach until the Shizuku-Amane incident interrupts the tournament mood.
casualties: ikki-kurogane suffers many cuts, skull/arm trauma and severe bruising
periods.significance: Shows Ikki can defeat an A-class-level cheat ability without his trump card by combining analysis, body sacrifice and true inner resolve; also completes Sara's transformation into a serious artist rival.
